summary: This regulation explains how companies must share annual reports and meeting notices with people who hold certain non-convertible securities. Companies must send soft copies, web links, or hard copies of annual reports depending on whether the investor registered an email or asked for a physical copy. Companies must also send meeting notices and proxy forms that allow investors to vote for or against each resolution.
points: Must send soft copies of full annual reports to holders who registered their email addresses with the company or a depository.
Must send a letter with a web link to the annual report and optionally a QR code to holders who have not registered their email addresses.
Must send hard copies of full annual reports to holders who specifically request them.
Must send notices for all meetings of holders of non-convertible debt securities and non-convertible redeemable preference shares, stating that proxy rules apply.
Must send proxy forms that let holders vote either for or against each resolution.
example: At Aarav Logistics Private Limited, some investors hold non-convertible debt securities. For investors like Rohan, who registered his email, the company emails a soft copy of the full annual report. For Priya, who has not registered her email, Aarav Logistics sends a letter providing the exact web-link to the annual report along with a Quick Response Code. Meanwhile, Vikram requested a physical copy, so the company sends him a hard copy. When holding a meeting for these security holders, Aarav Logistics sends them meeting notices stating that proxy rules apply, along with proxy forms designed so they can vote either for or against each resolution.

terms.meaning: Investments like bonds or preference shares that cannot be converted into equity shares of the company.
An organization that holds securities in electronic form for investors.
A person appointed by a security holder to attend and vote at a meeting on their behalf.

watch: Do not assume that all investors automatically get hard copies, as physical reports are only sent to those who request them or whose emails are missing.
